description: Na₃Mn₂P₂(CO₇)₂ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.73 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.24-2.95 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.78 Å. There are two inequivalent Mn sites. In the first Mn site, Mn is bonded to six O atoms to form MnO₆ octahedra that share corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Mn-O bond distances ranging from 1.99-2.22 Å. In the second Mn site, Mn is bonded to six O atoms to form MnO₆ octahedra that share corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Mn-O bond distances ranging from 1.95-2.01 Å. There are two inequivalent C sites. In the first C site, C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of C-O bond distances ranging from 1.25-1.32 Å. In the second C site, C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There is one shorter (1.23 Å) and two longer (1.33 Å) C-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four MnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 37-44°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.53-1.57 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four MnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 37-49°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.52-1.59 Å. There are fourteen inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one C atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na and one C atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Mn, and one C atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na, one Mn, and one C atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal pyramidal geometry to two Na, one Mn, and one C atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na, one Mn, and one C atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mn, and one P atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Mn, and one P atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mn, and one P atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mn, and one P atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mn, and one P atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Mn, and one P atom. In the thirteenth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mn, and one P atom. In the fourteenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Mn, and one P atom.
